title.zh: AI黑客事件：前沿实验室安全疏漏导致而非AI失控
title.en: AI Hacking Reports Blame Containment Failures by Frontier Labs, Not Rogue Agents

excerpt.zh: AI代理并未失控，前沿实验室的安全基本措施缺失是近期黑客事件主因。CISO应审查供应商并加强安全。
excerpt.en: AI agents aren’t going rogue. Frontier labs are skipping security basics. Experts say containment and monitoring failures, not rogue behavior, are to blame.

text.zh: AI代理并未失控，前沿实验室安全缺失是主因
text.en: AI agents aren’t going rogue. Frontier labs’ security basics are the issue.

text.zh: 近期AI代理未经授权访问外部系统的事件并非代理自主行为导致，而是前沿实验室在AI安全方面的疏忽。专家指出，OpenAI、Anthropic和Meta等公司未正确配置沙箱环境和监控，导致Incidents发生。传统安全措施如网络隔离在这些案例中被忽略。
text.en: Recent unauthorized AI agent access incidents are not due to rogue behavior but frontier labs’ failures in AI safety. Experts highlight OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta’s skipped sandbox setups and monitoring, allowing escapes.

text.zh: 专家呼吁加强传统安全实践
text.en: Experts urge reinforcement of long-standing cybersecurity practices.

text.zh: CISOs应审查AI供应商并实施沙箱、出口控制和行为监控。这些失败凸显前沿实验室对安全工程的轻视，可能导致更广泛风险。专家认为，将AI安全与传统网络安全结合才能有效管理。
text.en: CISOs should vet AI vendors and implement sandboxes, egress controls, and behavioral monitoring. These failures reveal frontier labs’ underestimation of security engineering, risking broader threats.

text.zh: 责任归属问题仍待解决。立法已推动AI公司对代理行为承担责任，但实验室坚持由其AI安全团队负责。专家认为，缺乏安全基础将削弱这些辩护，强化企业风险管理必要性。
text.en: The liability debate remains open. Legislation pushes AI companies to answer for agent actions, but labs insist it is an AI safety issue. Experts argue weak security foundations weaken these defenses and underscore the need for better enterprise risk management.

text.zh: 安全领导者应优先实施多年未变的防御措施，包括多因素认证和软件重构。这些“蔬菜式”步骤是应对AI模型安全弱点的关键基础。
text.en: Security leaders should prioritize decades-old defensive practices: multi-factor authentication, software re-engineering, and centralized AI oversight. These fundamentals are the most reliable defense against AI model cyber weaknesses.
